name: hdtp-spec-whitepaper
description: Whitepaper PDF build for the HDTP specification.

scripts.docs:check: node scripts/check-refs.mjs --selftest && node schema/reference.mjs --check && node schema/examples.mjs
scripts.publish: wrangler r2 object put hdtp-private/hdtp-whitepaper.pdf --file dist/hdtp-whitepaper.pdf --remote && wrangler r2 object put hdtp-private/hdtp-whitepaper.meta.json --file dist/hdtp-whitepaper.meta.json --content-type application/json --remote
